candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. E no dey cough and e no dey get wahala to breathe. E no dey vomit everything. E no get fever. E no get diarrhoea. E no dey convulse now and e never convulse before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E get ear problem. Caregiver talk say ear discharge dey, and di discharge don dey for 13 days. E pus dey drain from ear. E no dey complain of ear pain and e no get tender swelling for back of ear.
